lines.text: The dark face that rose from the Goddess of Victory statue looks at them.
It stares with vacant eyes.
Its arms. Its wings.
Its entire form is an obvious insult to the Goddess of Victory,
while also an aspiration to become her.
*Whoosh*
It swings its arms around.
It strikes down toward the surface.
*Kaboom!*
It craters the surface, and Dark Matter shoots up.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: There's our opening! Let's go!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hyaaaah!
Behemoth charges, the ground trembling in her wake.
The thing swings a fist at the face of the enormous bull.
There's a head-on collision.
*Crunch*
With a horrible noise, Behemoth crumples like a can in a press.
Her transformation is immediately undone.
She can't hide her shock.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What...?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Looks like this is the real monster.
The thing squeezes Behemoth and Eunhwa.
*Rumble, rumble!*
It charges, scraping the hand holding the two of them along the ground.
It then hurls them.
Behemoth and Eunhwa go flying, their limbs bent at odd angles like dolls with broken joints.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: How dare you...!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hyaaaah!
Ziz rapidly flies near the thing and launches her feathers at it.
Leviathan opens her jaw wide and rushes.
Emma and Vesti are still atop them.
*Crunch!*
The thing's neck bends at an odd angle, and it takes a bite out of Ziz.
*Crunch!*
It grabs Leviathan's jaw and tears.
Ziz and Emma fall, while Leviathan and Vesti lie collapsed on the ground.
The thing opens it jaw wide toward them.
*Kreeeeee!*
*Crack!*
The red light coming from its mouth swallows them up and pounds the surface.
*Flash!*
*Boooom!*
There's a blinding flash and an explosion.
An enormous crater appears in the ground.
The thing raises its head and looks forward.
*Kreeeee!*
It bellows.
It lets out an odd roar, mixed with the sound of machinery.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Pierce through!
*Boom!*
Seven Dwarves fires.
Half of the thing's dark face disappears.
Immediately, red light pours from its mouth as a counterattack.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That's quick...!
Snow White is caught in the red light explosion.
She blocks it with a reactive shield, which falls apart almost instantly.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You monster...!
With an eerie crunching sound, the thing's face heals itself.
Its recovery is slow! It won't be long now!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Sweeter tidings I have not heard.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Forward, Trombe!
Trombe charges forward with Crown and Scarlet on its back.
The thing reaches its hand out and tries to grab Trombe.
The enormous dark hand is right in front of Trombe.
The horse changes direction and runs up the arm.
It climbs close to the head.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Here I take my leave.
Scarlet jumps off the running Trombe.
She goes flying toward the thing's head, raising her hands to her scabbard.
*Slash, slash, slash, slash!*
A large number of cuts appear on the thing's face.
Crown, her spear out, races toward that spot on Trombe's back.
*Bang!*
Part of the thing's face bursts. Crown and Trombe continue forward, coming out the other side.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Incredible, Your Highness!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I shall not be overtopped.
*Slash, slash, slash, slash!*
She unleashes another barrage of sword strikes.
The thing's head is sliced into pieces and soon disappears.
Now that its head is gone, a black gleaming core is revealed in its neck.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: There's the core.
*Crackle*
Its head is quickly regenerated.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The core's gone.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: We can see that.
The thing waves its arms wildly.
Trombe loses its footing.
Their long race over, Crown and Trombe are nearly thrown to the ground.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Y-Your Highness!
Crown checks on herself and Trombe.
Trombe is in pieces. Crown can feel that one of her legs is ruined.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: ... It is stronger than I thought.
The thing keeps swinging its arms.
Scarlet nimbly avoids the arms and keeps swinging her sword.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis naught but a pair of arms.
*Crack*
It splits each of its arms into four.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... A sour jest.
The thing pounds its eight arms wildly on the ground.
Scarlet hastily moves out of the way.
*Bang, bang, bang, bang!*
The ground heaves, and Dark Matter churns.
Everyone is in a rush to avoid the attack.
*Kreeeee!*
The thing joins its arms again. With a screech, it lifts its arms and pounds them on the ground.
There's a burst of light.
An explosion bursts, causing a thick cloud of smoke.
Through the smoke, a red light flickers.
Beam incoming!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Dorothy!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Let's go.
Marian unleashes a barrage of great dark spears.
Dorothy floats, firing an onslaught of white lights.
They fly through the smoke, hitting the spot where the red light flickers.
*Kreeeee!*
The smoke clears, and the thing screams, its face pockmarked by spears.
The red light in its mouth spews all around it.
*Boom, boom, boom!*
There's a mess of explosions. It's impossible to see anything through the bursts and flying fragments.
The thing swipes its hand through the mess of explosions and fragments.
We can't dodge that...!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Don't worry!
Rapunzel suddenly appears and steps in front of me.
Golden walls appear in a thick layer, and the thing strikes it with its hand.
*Kkkkrrrrk!*
The golden walls shatter, but the hand is blown backwards.
Rapunzel also goes flying back, rolling along the ground.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Ugh... *Cough...!*
Bright red blood bursts from her lips.
The thing's posture is a unsteady.
In its awkward pose, it swings its arms again.
Scarlet leaps in front of Rapunzel, crouching low.
She unsheathes her sword, pointing it toward the oncoming dark hand.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I shall show thee what it means to render heaven and earth asunder.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Hmm... But whether that be from heaven and earth, I know not.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: No matter. I shall cleave it in twain and know anon.
*Slash*
There's a sound so faint you could only hear it if you were listening for it.
It's a satisfying, crisp sound.
At some point, the outstretched sword cut the thing's arm in half.
The shockwave from her blade charges forward, splitting the thing's head.
Between the halves of the head,
the darkly shining core is revealed.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Rapi! Go!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Seven Dwarves Zero! Fully active!
Rapi activates her drill and runs.
Snow White's Seven Dwarves,
Dorothy's white light,
and Marian's black spears follow her.
The hastily regenerating head bursts.
The black core is revealed immediately after,
and Rapi pierces it with her drill.
*Rumble, rumble!*
It's not enough. Her power alone can't break it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hnrgh...!
*Rumble, rumble!*
Seven Dwarves Zero lets out a whine. It's nearly at its limit.
The thing's head regenerates, and it tries regenerating its arms.
It's desperate. It recovers at a previously unmatched speed.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Stop it from regenerating.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Queen...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thy persistency hath no end!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: But neither does ours...!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Hyaaah!
Everyone focuses their full attention on attacking the thing's head.
They have to break through before the thing's head regenerates.
*Kkkkrrrk*

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's not... working...!
The drill's power lessens.
The thing keeps trying to create a new head and arms.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Ngh...!
Rapi suddenly feels heat behind her.
The heat overwhelms her.
*Boom*
*Flash!*
A golden explosion and a flash of starlight burst from the core.
Rapi doesn't turn around. She senses that Anis and Neon have arrived.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hyaaaah!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Firepowerrrrr!
Anis and Neon run toward the core.
Anis pounds her fists into the core.
Neon presses the muzzle of her gun onto the core and unleashes a barrage of bullets.
*Rumble, rumble!*
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*
*Flash! Flash! Flash!*

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: This thing is stupidly tough!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: No kidding! I bet someone would pay good money for it!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Let's sell the pieces later and make a fortune!
The red trail, starlight, and gold light up the whole area.
Then suddenly,
the starlight and gold begin to fuse with the red trail.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What... the...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It's all getting sucked in...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Whoa! It's a Counters team attack!
The drill spins,
and the trail that had been red before,
now shines brilliantly with gold and starlight as well.
Rapi, Anis, and Neon sense it.
They can break the core with this.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Do it, Rapi! Pierce through this thing!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Pierce through it, Rapi!
Rapi! Do iiittt!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pierce... through...!
*Rumble, rumble!*
The drill digs into the black core.
It advances bit by bit.
Soon...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Aaaaaaah...!
*Crash!*
The black core breaks with a bright sound,
and inside,
they see the strongest Nikke, Liliweiss.
The thing flails its fists.
It aims for Rapi's drill.
Rapi decides her drill can face it head-on.
She speeds up and clashes with the thing's fist.
*Kakakakak*
She miscalculated.
*Crack*
The thing's fist pierces the drill,
splitting Seven Dwarves Zero into pieces
and heading for Rapi's stomach.
*Crack*
With a dizzying pain that knocks her unconscious,
Rapi senses it.
The core is broken.
Rapi goes flying. She lands helplessly on the ground.
Her stomach is caved in, and her eyes, while open, are unfocused.
Rapunzel hastily rushes over.
Soon, her eyes are filled with despair.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Damn yooouuu...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Aaahhh!
Neon shoves her gun into the thing's face and fires rapidly.
With each burst, golden particles cause an explosion.
The thing swings its fist through the explosions.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ack...!
*Bang!*
It strikes Neon in the forehead. A shockwave and an ear-splitting sound ring out.
Neon gags as blood spills from her eyes, nose, ears, and mouth.
Anis pushes her core's output to the limit.
The searing pain tells her she's cutting her life shorter,
but she has to do this now.
There's a flash and the gleam of a star as Anis transitions to Starlight Mode and swings her fists wildly at the thing.
Her fists pound countless times each moment.
The thing accepts all her blows without moving.
As time slows,
Anis notices the thing following her fists with its eyes.

lines.speaker: anis_i_s
lines.text: ... No way.
The thing's fists slowly move.
It reaches forward, aiming for Anis's swinging fists.
Anis can't pull back her arms.
Now that time has slowed, she feels it.
The thing's fists burst through her own and continue forward.
With time slowed down, she feels the complete pain of her arms and shoulders breaking.
*Boom*
Anis's arms, shoulders, and part of her torso burst into pieces.
In response to the pain that far exceeds her capacity, her brain disconnects.
Rapi, Anis, Neon...
Marian tries to go running, but Crown holds out an arm to stop her.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Those two come first.
Marian taps her staff on the ground.
Dark Matter moves, carrying the unconscious Anis and Neon to her.
Rapunzel hastily checks on them.
She silently focuses on her healing.
Rapunzel...
Rapunzel!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Commander...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Quiet. Are you trying to destroy morale completely?
*Crumble*
The Goddess of Victory statue collapses.
Soon, it turns to Dark Matter and washes away.
It's as if a black rain is falling.
Standing in the black rain,
The thing stares at the group.
It looks at them with a smile.
Looking at its face, the Commander is now certain.
It's a machine.
It's just a machine.
A machine that can only imitate a smile.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Queen...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... With such might, wherefore did it not attack in its true form from the first?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It's obvious why it didn't.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Look at its face.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Damn, she's pretty.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The wound from when I shot it in the forehead,

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: the hand mangled from Rapi's drill,

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: the wounds from Anis's and Neon's attacks...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: None of it has healed.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It can't regenerate.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Why not? Is recovery not its chiefest skill?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Perhaps the Queen doth understand yet little of Liliweiss's body.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It likely sought to keep her from the fray.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though she be the strongest, it cannot use her according to its will.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: In other words, we can wear it down.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: And if we can wear it down, we can end it.
Crown takes a step forward.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Then I'll take the safeguard.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You mean "vanguard," Your Highness.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Crown, I hope you don't mean alone...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I want everyone to stay back, or you might get caught up in this.
Crown speaks firmly as she walks slowly toward it.
Chime detects a faint difference in her unwavering steps.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your Highness, your leg...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Chime.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Watch my back.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Okay.
Crown continues walking forward.
Alva Particle Conversion-Type Expansive Armament.
Naked King.
Activate.
A thermal shockwave bursts out.
Unable to withstand the heat, Crown's clothes start to burn.
She is clothed in her royal armor.
Wariness appears in the thing's eyes.

lines.speaker: crown_n
lines.text: Like I said, I don't want anyone to come close or you'll get caught up in it too.
Crown gestures.
A thermal wave covers the enemy in front of her.
It stumbles, losing its posture.
A look of bewilderment appears on its face.
Crown walks slowly with dignity.
Her each and every step sends a shockwave.
The thing raises its arms to protect its body.
*Boooom! Boooom! Boooom!*
The area around them is ruined.
The ground shatters and is torn away, and the air vibrates.
*Thud*
The thing falls to its knees.
Crown doesn't stop.
She keeps waving her hand, sending shockwaves rumbling.
*Boooom!*
The thing reaches out its hand.
*Boooom!*
The thing stumbles and places its hand on the ground.
*Boooom!*
Crown looks down on it, her hands continually moving.
The thing looks up at Crown as it rides out the shockwaves.
It recognizes the expression on her face from its database.
It's the same expression it saw on an object of similar nature in the imitation Ark.
The expansive armament Naked King.
It boasts incredible attack power, but it is a weapon designed solely for annihilation, unable to distinguish between friend and foe.
It is a weapon that allows the destruction of your enemies with a step and a flick of the wrist, as though it were made for dignity.
It is a weapon that will take care of everything so long as you continue walking onward alone.
It is an overwhelming power and a lonely one.
If the one wearing Naked King should seize victory on the battlefield, she seizes it alone.
When she falls, she falls alone too.
It is a noble and lonely weapon.
Chime always thought it was the perfect weapon for Crown,
who left herself hollow in order to fulfill the wishes of others.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Your Highness.
Chime stops the others who try to step forward.
Crown in her robes must fight and die alone.
As Chime watches the fight between Crown and the thing, she grows certain.
She knows how it will end,
but she doesn't turn her eyes away.
She must watch Her Highness from behind,
until the very end.
Even if it's the final time she sees her hollow king.
Crown's gestures begin to appear tired.
In an instant, the thing is upon her.
Crown tries to take a step back, but the pain in her leg makes her hesitate.
She feels a dizzying shock in her leg.
With a kick, the thing strikes Crown's leg and tears it off.
As Crown loses her balance and begins to fall,
she sees the thing's fist.
*Bang!*
Her head snaps back. Crown collapses, grabbing the thing's arm.
*Bang!*
*Boooom!*
*Bang!*
*Boooom!*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your... Highness...
Crown holds on to the thing's arm and continues firing shockwaves.
The thing pounds on Crown who refuses to let go.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ngh... *Sob...*
*Bang!*
*Boooom!*
*Bang!*
*Boooom!*
*Bang!*
*Bang!*
When everyone realizes they no longer hear the shockwaves, they rush forward.
*Bang!*
*Whish*
Crown flies in front of Chime.
Everyone runs toward the thing, their eyes filled with fury.
*Thud*
Crown falls before Chime in a flurry of red and gold.
Chime tries to carefully lift her,
but she can't touch her. She doesn't know where to grab on.
It feels like Crown will fall apart no matter where she puts her hand.
Rapunzel rushes over and begins healing her.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Agh... Ngh... *Sob...!*

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Your... Your Highness...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: It's okay. She's alive.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... R-really?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Sh-she'll wake up in just a moment, right? Right?
Chime pulls the Crown Kingdom flag out of her backpack.
She covers Crown's body with it.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Still... still....

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I watched you. I watched you the whole time.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I didn't take my eyes off you for even a second, Your Highness.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You were so... so... majestic.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You looked... incredible.
Chime wipes her tears and turns to look at the people fighting.
Then she shouts.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: The arms! Aim for the arms!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Her Highness put her life on the line to wear that thing down!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: That is the greatest gift she could bestow on you!

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Don't you dare let it go to waste!
Andersen watches them fight the thing.
He then silently looks down at his own hand.
He raises his head again to watch the Nikkes fight.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Hyaah!
Marian creates countless black spears in the air.
She launches all of them forward.
The thing swings its fists and destroys all of the spears flying at it.
Hidden among the spears, Dorothy flies forward.
She flies dizzily around the thing, launching her light.
As the thing crouches, blocking the spears and Dorothy's attacks, its gaze darts around.
It reaches out and grabs Dorothy's wings.
*Bang!*
It slams Dorothy on the ground.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Ugh...!
It tears off her wings and stomps on her.
*Boom!*

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Ugh...!
She doesn't die. Her body regenerates.
The thing stares at Dorothy with a suspicious gaze.
Then, it swings its fist at her.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: How darest thou!
*Clang!*
Scarlet swings her sword, deflecting the thing's fist.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou wilt not break my blade again...!
*Clang! Clash!*
Scarlet's sword clashes with the thing's fist.
Their high speed battle continues.
The thing blocks Scarlet's barrage of sword strikes with its arms.
Its eyes keep tracing the arc of the sword.
*Clang!*
As Scarlet swings with all her might, the thing deflects her sword.
Scarlet's body twists.
The thing uses that opening to land a blow with its fist.
*Bang!*

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Kegh...!
Its fist drives deep into Scarlet's torso.
Scarlet grits her teeth.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Though I doubt not thy skill, Maiden Cecil,

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: this attire doth weigh me down heavily. It fits ill with my talents.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: It's to decrease the risk if you get hit.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I know how it looks, but it's not actually that heavy, is it?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You'll be able to fight just as you normally do. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Is this not of little use if I am never struck? Rather than such heavy armor, I want...

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're going to get hit.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: By Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: With a monster like that, what matters isn't how many times you get hit.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You could get killed or seriously wounded with a single blow.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: with this,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: you can survive a single blow.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: And that makes this armor more than worth it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Ay...! Thy words ring true...!
*Shatter!*
Scarlet's armor shatters and crumbles.
Inside, red and black,
colors like a wilting rose are revealed.
Scarlet raises her sword high.
A red blade comes flying, attaching to her sword.
Beyond the Fade.
For just one day,
the red flower blooms again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Let us go together, Rose.
A metallic sound rings out for a brief moment.
The thing's arm goes flying.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: It would seem thou art not invincible.
She adjusts her grip and strikes again.
The thing crouches low and swings its fist up at the sword.
*Bang!*

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Not invincible... but thy strength remains...
Scarlet's arms and sword shatter to pieces.
However, the red blade doesn't lose its shine or shape.
Dorothy, who'd been slammed into the ground, springs to her feet.
She grabs the red blade and stabs it into the thing's chest.
*Stab*

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Arrrrrghhh!
Dorothy twists her body in the air and lands a roundhouse kick on the thing's head.
There's a loud crack as the thing falls, its head slamming into the ground.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: As I said then, thou shouldst use a sword...
The thing springs to its feet. As it does, it lands a kick on Scarlet's chin.
Scarlet loses consciousness, and she collapses as her legs crumble beneath her. The thing swings a fist at her face.
Dorothy steps in front of it and fires a barrage from her gun, but the thing takes all her blows and swings with its fist.
With a sickening thunk, its fist sinks into Dorothy's torso, and she and Scarlet go flying in a tangle.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Queen...!
*Shove*
Snow White charges forward. She shoves the long barrel of Seven Dwarves against the things body.
The gun ramps up, and then...
*Thunk!*
Seven Dwarves spews light.
*Fwoooom*
The light keeps pouring out. The thing allows the light to wash over it and tries to move its remaining arm bit by bit.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Die!
*Fwoooom*
Snow White looks at the thing being consumed by light.
She looks into Liliweiss's face.
Snow White tries to remember her dear Lilith's face.
What did it look like?
She can't remember now.
She looks at the thing's face,
its expressionless face.
She can't sense a shred of emotion coming from it.
If there's one thing I know for certain, this wasn't her face.
*Fwoooom*
The light continues to pour out.
*Boom, boom!*
As Seven Dwarves overheats, sparks and smoke fly out, and small explosions burst.
But Snow White doesn't stop. She keeps firing.
She fires as if trying to rip out the thing wearing Lilith's skin.
*Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
She launches all missiles and fires all bullets.
They're so close that Snow White feels the shock of the explosions too. But she doesn't stop.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Die...! Die...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dieeeee...!
*Crack!*
The thing crushes the muzzle of the flashing Seven Dwarves.
Light explodes and bursts in all directions.
A tremendous explosion burst out.
Inside the smoke from the explosion, a series of loud noises ring out.
Soon, Snow White's tattered body is thrown from inside the smoke cloud.
Rapunzel feels the impulse to run over right away,
but too many people have been injured. Many of them have suffered severe wounds.
Her most pressing task is helping the severely wounded cling to life.
Rapunzel turns to Marian, the only one left standing.
Marian's eyes are closed.
Before Rapunzel can wonder what's going on, the sky turns black.
Hundreds of black spears aim at the same place.
The black spears aim for the thing.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
The ground is turned to ruin.
The thing starts moving rapidly to avoid the onslaught of spears.
Any that miss the thing change direction and fly toward it again.
It can't avoid them.
The thing stands still, adjusting its posture.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
It takes some hits and deflects the rest.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
The number it deflects decreases noticeably. It begins taking an overwhelming majority of the attacks.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
It takes all of the attacks. It doesn't deflect any.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
It runs toward Marian, even as every black spear pierces its body.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... You were waiting until it was an amount you could reasonably endure.
*Boom, boom, boom, boom!*
*Whoosh*
The thing reaches out and grabs Marian's face.
It slams her into the ground.
It swings its only arm wildly.
*Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!*

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Ngh...! Aah...!
It stomps on her.
*Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!*

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Ugh...! Agh!
*Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!*
*Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!*
The sound grows fainter.
The thing looks down.
All that's left is something torn to pieces.
*Thud*
The thing falls to its knees.
It breathes heavily.
*Splatter*
It vomits up blood.
It studies its own blood for a while.
It turns its head when it feels vibrations coming from beside it.
Andersen and the Commander are running toward it,
protected by several layers of Rapunzel's shields.
The thing somehow reaches the conclusion that it shouldn't touch them.
It stumbles and waves its hand.
*Boom*
It emits a shockwave that instantly shatters all the shields.
Andersen and the Commander go flying in a shower of fragments.
They both fall, blood pouring from them.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Ack... urgh...!
Agh...!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Commander! Believer!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou wretch...!
Rapunzel and Nayuta run,
but another shockwave blows them helplessly into the ground.
The thing looks under its feet again.
Marian is slowly regenerating.
The thing reaches its hand towards Marian's core.
Sparks fly from the Commander's eyes.
Don't touch her...!
He runs.
Another shockwave causes him to spit up blood.
He runs again.
Another shockwave causes him to spit up more blood.
He runs, collapses, runs, collapses.
The Commander dies dozens of times.
But he gets back up and runs.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Believer...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: What a... grievous sight...
Don't you... touch Marian...!
The thing stares at the approaching Commander.
It launches another shockwave with disinterest, sending the Commander flying.
It stomps again on Marian.
At least it tries to...
Marian is standing in front of it.
The thing reflexively tries to punch her, but it's too late.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Don't touch my Commander.
*Flash!*
A black light bursts out.
It forms a black moon and shrinks.
Hyper-condensed Dark Matter gathers in Marian's hand,
and in a moment, it's released.
The thing is fully exposed to the Dark Matter tidal wave that rushes toward it extremely fast.
The wave stops, and the thing falls to its knees.
Marian falls to her knees as well.
They watch each other, breathing heavily.
The thing stumbles to its feet and slowly walks toward Marian.
Then it stops.
It senses something.
It detects an energy source unlike anything in its database.
It turns to head toward the source.
Rapi is glaring at it.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mm...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: She was asleep for so long, I thought something was wrong.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Is it because you handed over your core and gene?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I'm not a Queen anymore.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Soon I won't be a Queen at all.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: So the transfer isn't instantaneous, then.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: But soon it'll be gone for good.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: What is it? What's happening?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Are you still feeling sick? You should get more rest...

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: That's too bad.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: What is...?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mommy.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: If Mommy had gotten it earlier, I bet we would be even closer.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe. But it's okay.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mommy likes me, and I like her.
A red haze blooms from Rapi's body.
Her eyes stare directly at the thing.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Neon, Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Rapi...
Rapi glares at the thing.
She walks forward slowly
and comes to a stop in front of it.
They look at each other.
The thing swings a fist at Rapi's face.
Rapi ducks, dodging the fist and unleashing her own counterattack.
*Thwack!*
The thing doubles over.
Rapi swings a fist at the thing's face.
It goes flying and rolls along the ground. It springs to its feet and watches Rapi.
Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm all right, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm all right now. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: But how...? Your core was broken...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The gene...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I see...!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The consort who comforted the Queen made by the Maleficent Beast Quartet...!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis Young Lady Rapi!
The thing runs toward Rapi.
It swings its fist wildly.
Rapi narrowly dodges its attacks.
She responds with a counterattack every chance she gets.
The thing stumbles. It attacks Rapi with wild abandon.
This time, it's prepared for the counterattack.
It matches Rapi's fist and strikes it away.
Its fist barely brushes her chin.
Rapi stumbles. Her mind grows hazy.
The thing uses that opening to go in for another attack.
*Pshoom!*
The thing is surrounded by light.
Smoke billows from Dorothy's gun.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Always the coward, Dorothy!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Focus!
The three of them fight in a tangle.
Rapi and the thing are evenly matched in close combat.
Rapi, whose specs have dramatically increased due to the influence of the gene, responds to every attack.
If she gets hit, she'll die. That fact hasn't changed.
But she matches it blow for blow
by using all the battle experience she's obtained and all the senses she's honed in close combat.
However, the thing learns at an alarmingly fast speed.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Are you adapting to me...?!
The battle is close. It's getting harder for her to dodge.
The thing is adapting to her patterns.
One blow out of ten, one out of seven, one out of three... The frequency with which her life is put in danger only increases.
Each time that happens, Dorothy's shots save Rapi's life.
Dorothy flies low to the ground, circling around the thing and shooting at it.
She uses all her strength. She may have been turned into a Heretic, but she still has her limit.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: One hit.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: We just need to land one decisive hit.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll... do it...!
Marian staggers to her feet.
She grits her teeth. Her vision flashes, and she feels like she might pass out at any moment.
She looks at the Commander.
She sees the Commander looking at her in her ruined state.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I will protect you no matter what, Commander.
Marian gathers all the Dark Matter in the area to her.
She creates a black moon and compresses it more and more.
Marian's bandages gleam.
*Rumble...*
It sucks in all Dark Matter.
The thing senses something and stops moving.
It stops attacking Rapi and runs to Marian.
Rapi chases after it.
In her haste, she doesn't have time to defend when the thing turns around and lands a blow in her stomach.
*Slam!*

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Kegh...!
*Crumble*
Most of her frame is ruined. Her core must have taken a serious hit too.
Blood spills from Rapi's mouth as she collapses.
The thing tries to keep running.
It tries to run toward Marian.
Rapi desperately reaches her arms out.
She grabs the things legs and refuses to let go.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Where... are you... going?!
Her sudden movement hampers the thing's steps.
Dorothy takes advantage of its brief wobbling to fire.
The thing accepts Dorothy's attack and lifts a foot, aiming it at Rapi.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Rapi...!
She can't stop it by shooting. Dorothy quickly approaches it in the air.
Just then, the thing's foot lands safely on the ground, and it doubles over.
It's a completely different behavior.
While it poured it its aggression before,
it's now attempting to lure and deceive.
Dorothy finds its rapid growth
much more chilling than its attacks.
*Thwack!*

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Ugh...!
It unleashes an uppercut that strikes Dorothy in the head.
It feels like the pain will rip her apart. She desperately clings to consciousness.
Her body won't move the way she wants it to.
Only a single thought keeps her moving.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Agh...! Ugh...!
Dorothy pulls the thing toward her with all her might.
She squeezes it tight so it can't move.
Rapi grabs on to the thing's legs.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Urk...! Agh...!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Agh...! Hngh...!
The thing desperately tries to tear itself away from Rapi and Dorothy.
But it can't. It's used too many resources.
It frantically turns its head to look at Marian.
Marian meets its gaze with unwavering eyes.
It stares at the brilliant black light
flickering around her fingertips.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Return...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... to where you belong.
The thing is covered in black light.
